output: html_document

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
    library(dplyr)
    library(ComplexHeatmap)
    library(ggplot2)
    library(patchwork)
    library(ggrepel)
    library(ggpubr)
    library(ggrepel)
})

theme_md_classic <- function() {
    theme_classic(
        base_size = 6, 
        base_family = "ArialMT",
        base_line_size = 0.25,
        base_rect_size = 0.25
    ) %+replace% theme(
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 6),
        axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 6),  # was size 8 in other notebooks?
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 8),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 6),
        complete = TRUE
    )
}

theme_md_bw <- function() {
    theme_bw(
        base_size = 6, 
        base_family = "ArialMT",
        base_line_size = 0.25,
        base_rect_size = 0.25
    ) %+replace% theme(
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 6),
        axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 6),
        strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 8),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 6),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "black"),
        complete = TRUE
    )
}
```

# [SKIP] with 4k hvgs model

```{r}
pdir <- "/Volumes/krienen/lab_members/mike/260216_Spatial_Panel_Eval"
outdir <- file.path(pdir, "random_forest_classifier/4k_hvgs")
plotdir <- file.path(outdir, "plots")

if (!dir.exists(plotdir))
    dir.create(plotdir)
```


```{r}
feat_imp <- read.csv(file.path(outdir, "feature_importances.csv"))
feat_imp <- feat_imp[,-1]
feat_imp$Spatial.Panel <- as.logical(toupper(feat_imp$Spatial.Panel))
names(feat_imp) <- c("gene", "importance", "spatial_panel")
```


```{r}
# > table(feat_imp$spatial_panel)
# FALSE  TRUE 
#  3804   196 
```

```{r}
ggplot(feat_imp, aes(spatial_panel, importance)) + 
    geom_boxplot() + 
    theme_md_classic()
```

```{r}
feat_imp %>% 
    mutate(
        rank_pct = rank(importance) / 4e3
    ) %>% 
    filter(spatial_panel) %>% 
    ggplot(aes("Spatial Panel", rank_pct)) + 
    geom_boxplot(color="red") + 
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) + 
    # scale_x_(labels = "Spatial Panel") + 
    labs(y = "Rank Percentile", x=NULL) + 
    theme_md_classic() + 
    theme() -> p2
p2
```

```{r}
feat_imp %>% 
    mutate(
        rank_pct = rank(importance) / 4e3
    ) %>% 
    arrange(spatial_panel) %>% 
    ggplot(
        aes(importance, rank_pct, color = spatial_panel)
    ) + 
    geom_point() + 
    scale_color_manual(values = c("gray", "red")) + 
    labs(
        x = "Feature Importance",
        y = "Rank Percentile",
        color = "Gene in\nSpatial Panel"
    ) + 
    theme_md_classic() -> p1
p1
```

```{r}
{
    p1 + scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent)
} + p2 + plot_layout(widths = c(3, 1))
```

```{r}
feat_imp %>% 
    mutate(
        rank_pct = rank(importance) / 4e3
    ) %>% 
    # remake this so that we don't plot by in-vs-not-in panel, but by only
    # panel vs. all 4k hvgs
    (function(x) {
        out <- x[, -3]
        out$set <- "All 4k HVGs"
        x <- filter(x, spatial_panel)
        x <- x[,-3]
        x$set <- "Spatial Panel Genes"
        rbind(out, x)
    }) %>% 
    ggplot(aes(set, rank_pct)) + 
    geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.5, outlier.shape = 16) + 
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, expand=c(0, 0)) +
    labs(
        x = NULL, y = "Feature Importance Percentile",
        title = "Random Forest Classifier\nFeature Importance"
    ) + 
    theme_md_classic() + 
    theme(
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle=30, hjust=1)
    )
```

```{r}
ggsave(
    file.path(plotdir, "boxplot_rank_pct_importance_all-vs-panel.pdf"),
    width=40, height=50, units="mm"
)
```

```{r}
    file.path(plotdir, "boxplot_rank_pct_importance_all-vs-panel2.pdf"),
    width=25, height=50, units="mm"
)
```

# with union of 4k hvgs and spatial panel

```{r}
pdir <- "/Volumes/krienen/lab_members/mike/260216_Spatial_Panel_Eval"
outdir <- file.path(pdir, "random_forest_classifier/union_4k_hvgs_spatial_panel")
plotdir <- file.path(outdir, "plots")

if (!dir.exists(plotdir))
    dir.create(plotdir)
```

```{r}
path_spatial_panel <- '/Volumes/krienen/lab_members/daisy/hmba/xenium_genes_2024.csv'
path_hvgs <- "/Volumes/krienen/marm_hmba_integration/250602_reprocess_and_recluster/data/rna/preprint_freeze/RNA_HVG_4K_preprint_freeze.csv"

panel_gns <- read.csv(path_spatial_panel)[[1]]
hvgs <- read.csv(path_hvgs)[[1]]
```

```{r}
feat_imp <- read.csv(file.path(outdir, "feature_importances_4104__1000_trees.csv"))
names(feat_imp) <- c("gene", "importance")
```

and add rank importance 

```{r}
feat_imp$rank_pct = rank(feat_imp$importance) / nrow(feat_imp)
```

make separate rows for each gene set, so that we allow overlapping genes to
appear in both in plots

```{r}
rbind(
    mutate(filter(feat_imp, gene %in% hvgs), set = "4k HVGs"),
    mutate(filter(feat_imp, gene %in% panel_gns), set = "Spatial Panel Genes")
) %>% 
    ggplot(aes(set, rank_pct)) + 
    geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.5, outlier.shape = 16) + 
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, expand=c(0, 0)) +
    labs(
        x = NULL, y = "Feature Importance Percentile",
        title = "Random Forest Classifier\nFeature Importance"
    ) + 
    theme_md_classic() + 
    theme(
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle=30, hjust=1)
    )
```

```{r}
ggsave(
    file.path(plotdir, "boxplot_rank_pct_importance_hvgs-vs-panel.pdf"),
    width=40, height=50, units="mm"
)
```

```{r}
ggsave(
    file.path(plotdir, "boxplot_rank_pct_importance_hvgs-vs-panel2.pdf"),
    width=25, height=50, units="mm"
)
```


```{r}
rbind(
    mutate(filter(feat_imp, gene %in% hvgs), set = "4k HVGs"),
    mutate(filter(feat_imp, gene %in% panel_gns), set = "Spatial Panel Genes")
) %>% 
    dplyr::group_by(set) %>% 
    summarize(median(rank_pct))
```

median panel gene in 86th percentile of feature importance

what are these useless panel genes?
[note that most of the lowest importance genes are in 4k HVGs alone]

```{r}

    mutate(

            "4k HVGs"
```
